sentences.text: (By Sri Veeranagouda Malipatil, Hcgp For R1 & R4;

Sri A. M. Nagral, Advocate For R3;
Sri Manvendra Reddy, Advocate For R2)

This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226
And 227 Of The Constitution Of India, Praying To
Issue The Suitable Writ In The Nature Of Certiorari
And Quash The Intimation Letter No.Kra-
Kaidb/Bhuswa/Ka/2018-19/239 Dated 06.10.2018 Issued
By The Respondent No.3 Vide Annexure-K. B) Issue
Directions To The Respondent No.1 To Refer The Case
To Deputy Commissioner I.E., Respondent No.4 Under
Section 29(3) Of The Kiadb Act, 1966.

C) Issue Suitable
Direction To The Respondent Nos.2 And 3 To Re-Survey
The Land Bearing Sy.No.74 Situated At Basveshwara
Nagar, Wadi, Tq. Chittapur, Dist. Kalaburagi Of The
Petitioner Proposed To Be Acquired For Wadi To
Gadag Railway Line Project.

This Writ Petition Is Coming On For Orders This
Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The petitioner has challenged a notice dated 06.10.2018 issued by respondent No.3 calling upon the NC: 2024:KHC-K:3596 petitioner to furnish documents in respect of his claim to compensation for the acquisition of the land bearing Sy.No.74 of Basaveshwar Nagar, Wadi, Chittapur Taluka.

When this petition was listed for orders, learned counsel for respondent No.3 submitted that pursuant to the notice challenged by the petitioner in this writ petition, a general award was passed determining the compensation payable and petitioner has received the compensation and therefore the writ petition does not survive for consideration.
This is not disputed by the learned counsel for the petitioner.
Hence, the petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.

Sd/-
